hypotheses: Keep four economically distinct actual equity-factor exposures, but remove fixed duration exposure and balance aggregate equity risk against gold risk rather than assuming four independent equity funds.
Compare the same monthly allocation with a daily, trailing-only portfolio-volatility target and a fixed5percentage-point trade band; no parameter grid or leveraged products.

methodology.monthly_weights: Four factor ETFs each receive25% of the equity sleeve. Balance that fixed basket and GLD by inverse63-session realized volatility, with equity share constrained to30%-70% of the98% invested budget.
methodology.daily_overlay: Use the most recent completed-month baseline target. Daily variant scales non-BIL holdings downward using trailing63-session covariance until target annualized volatility is at most12%; freed weight goes to BIL. Do not scale upward beyond the monthly baseline.
methodology.trade_trigger: Initial and monthly allocation requests trade. Between month ends, trade only when maximum desired-versus-actual closing weight difference is at least5percentage points. This band makes the volatility level a target, not a continuously enforced ceiling.
methodology.pending_orders: Never issue overlapping modeled orders. A monthly allocation update occurring while an older target is pending remains requested until the next eligible close; no pending target is silently overwritten.
methodology.execution: Decisions use observed closes only; fills occur at the next session open, or one further session with20bp stress. Identical USD10,000 andUSD1 commissions; no same-close or hindsight fills.
methodology.scope: Actual factor ETF portfolio, not new direct-stock fundamental signals. The SEC/stock-history blockers remain unchanged; no new factor is claimed, only two new fixed allocation configurations.
methodology.evidence: Register code, exact market panels and cutoff in the recurring program before calculating outcomes. Use its actual simulator/bt reviewer and unchanged Sharpe/SPY/15%drawdown goals.
methodology.selection_bias: This hypothesis was formed after previous negative factor experiments. All outcomes count; historical qualification is not independent future alpha.
